note: Set B captures more substantively correct claims — SIP thickness with vapor barrier, exterior-grade plywood, 3" steel decking, W10x15 beam section, plate hole diameter/spacing, and bolt size and head type — while Set A duplicates the same joist/frame/grade-level claims several times and adds garbled or misbound ones (e.g. 'ank nail', 'deck thickness 3/4"' bound to FIRST FLR, and W10 X 15 merged with 3" steel decking as one specification). Both sets misbind the 5'-2 1/2" and 8'-0" dimensions (they belong to the A1 deck module detail, not railing post spacing or deck connection spacing), and B also mislabels the 8'-0" as an A3 connection length. A additionally invents unsupported relations (scaffold footing 'connection: frame', bracket 'connection to joist') and offers tautological claims, so B is the cleaner and more faithful set overall.
